ideas.pitch: An offline-first deep-tech edge AI system running on localized hardware to detect micro-cracks and structural stress on railway tracks using acoustic emissions and computer vision.
ideas.title: DeepEdge Rail Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the deep-tech innovation focus of the event and features a hard physical/edge computing build, mirroring the winning pattern of unusual physical builds.

ideas.pitch: A deep-learning digital twin framework that simulates soil nutrient depletion and predicts irrigation anomalies using multi-spectral edge telemetry sensors.
ideas.title: AgriSense Soil Micro-Biome Neural Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a localized ML model coupled with sensor hardware to tackle a massive agricultural challenge relevant to Central India, appealing to incubation judges.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost brain-computer interface telemetry processing pipeline that translates motor-imagery EEG signals into assistive feedback for stroke rehabilitation.
ideas.title: MedFlux BCI Rehabilitation Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs complex biosignal processing (BCI) which showcases genuine hard engineering, directly matching the winning pattern from biomedical and neural hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent operational framework powered by lightweight local LLMs and anomaly detection to predict micro-grid failures before transformer overloads occur.
ideas.title: GridShield Autonomous Substation Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings complex multi-agent system design and predictive isolation forest models into industrial infrastructure, directly addressing deep-tech operational resilience.

ideas.pitch: An edge-deployed acoustic signature analyzer that listens to underground water distribution networks to isolate cavitation and pipe bursts in real-time without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: DeepWater Acoustic Pipeline Leak Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical infrastructural resource problem using localized digital signal processing and machine learning, fulfilling the core expectation of deep-tech innovation.
